name: M5Stack Unit Heart (MAX30100 pulse oximeter & heart-rate unit)
description: M5Stack Unit Heart: a Maxim (Analog Devices) MAX30100 optical pulse oximeter and heart-rate sensor on a Grove unit. Red (660 nm) and IR (880 nm) LEDs, a photodetector and a 16-bit ADC fill a 16-sample FIFO read over I2C at address 0x57, plus a die temperature sensor; your program turns the pulsing IR signal into beats per minute. On the unit an HT7533 makes 3.3 V (LED supply) and an RT9193 makes 1.8 V (chip VDD); two AO3400A MOSFET level shifters sit between the chip's I2C and the Grove SDA/SCL, which have 4.7 kOhm pull-ups to the Grove supply pin itself. So feed it 3.3 V from an ESP32 / Pico / Raspberry Pi (on 5 V the I2C lines would be pulled to 5 V). Sold as: M5Stack Unit Heart (SKU U029, MAX30100), 4-pin HY2.0-4P Grove connector GND, 5V, SDA, SCL, supplied with a 20 cm Grove cable.
eli5: Rest your fingertip on it and it shines red and infrared light into your skin; the light that bounces back wiggles with every heartbeat, so your board can count your pulse.

buildNotes: Grove wire colours on M5Stack cables: black GND, red 5V, yellow SDA, white SCL. Cut the cable or use a Grove-to-jumper lead for a breadboard.
Power it from 3.3 V: the unit's SDA/SCL pull-ups (R3, R4 4.7 kOhm) go to the red supply wire, so 5 V there puts 5 V on the I2C lines of a 3.3 V board.

On 3.3 V the HT7533 passes a little under 3.3 V to the LEDs; the MAX30100 needs at least 3.1 V there, so keep the LED current moderate (0x6 = 20.8 mA is a good start). Only use 5 V with a 5 V-tolerant I2C host.

Clear FIFO_WR_PTR, OVF_COUNTER and FIFO_RD_PTR before starting, then read 4 bytes per sample from FIFO_DATA (0x05): IR MSB, IR LSB, red MSB, red LSB. The register pointer does not advance while reading 0x05.
The FIFO holds only 16 samples (0.16 s at 100 sps): read it at least every 100 ms or samples are lost.
Rest the fingertip lightly and keep still; pressing hard squeezes the blood out and flattens the pulse. Not a medical device.

driver.code:
# MAX30100 pulse oximeter & heart-rate sensor (Maxim/Analog Devices), MicroPython driver.
# Register map, FIFO handling and temperature format from the MAX30100 datasheet (19-7065).
import time

_INT_STATUS = 0x00
_INT_ENABLE = 0x01
_FIFO_WR_PTR = 0x02
_OVF_COUNTER = 0x03
_FIFO_RD_PTR = 0x04
_FIFO_DATA = 0x05
_MODE_CONFIG = 0x06
_SPO2_CONFIG = 0x07
_LED_CONFIG = 0x09
_TEMP_INT = 0x16
_TEMP_FRAC = 0x17
_REV_ID = 0xFE
_PART_ID = 0xFF

MODE_HR = 0x02    # heart rate only: IR LED (red bytes of each sample read 0)
MODE_SPO2 = 0x03  # SpO2: IR and red LEDs

# SPO2_SR[2:0] -> samples per second (Table 4)
_RATES = (50, 100, 167, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000)
# LED_PW[1:0] -> pulse width in us (Table 5); ADC resolution 13, 14, 15, 16 bits
_WIDTHS = (200, 400, 800, 1600)


class MAX30100:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x57):
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        pid = self._r8(_PART_ID)
        if pid != 0x11:
            raise OSError('MAX30100 not found (part id 0x%02x): check wiring and pull-ups' % pid)
        self.reset()

    def _r8(self, reg):
        return self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, reg, 1)[0]

    def _w8(self, reg, val):
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, reg, bytes([val & 0xFF]))

    def part_id(self):
        return self._r8(_PART_ID)

    def revision(self):
        return self._r8(_REV_ID)

    def reset(self):
        """Soft reset (MODE_CONFIG RESET bit, cleared by the chip when done)."""
        self._w8(_MODE_CONFIG, 0x40)
        t0 = time.ticks_ms()
        while self._r8(_MODE_CONFIG) & 0x40:
            if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), t0) > 100:
                raise OSError('MAX30100 reset timed out')
            time.sleep_ms(1)

    def setup(self, mode=MODE_SPO2, sample_rate=100, pulse_width=1600, ir_current=0x6, red_current=0x6):
        """Configure and start sampling. sample_rate in sps (50..1000), pulse_width in us (200/400/800/1600),
        currents are the 4-bit RED_PA / IR_PA codes of Table 6 (0x6 = 20.8 mA, 0xF = 50 mA).
        The chip lowers the rate itself if it is too high for the pulse width."""
        sr = _RATES.index(sample_rate)
        pw = _WIDTHS.index(pulse_width)
        # SPO2_HI_RES_EN (bit 6) set as the datasheet asks; bit 5 reserved = 0.
        self._w8(_SPO2_CONFIG, 0x40 | (sr << 2) | pw)
        self._w8(_LED_CONFIG, ((red_current & 0x0F) << 4) | (ir_current & 0x0F))
        self._w8(_INT_ENABLE, 0x00)
        self.clear_fifo()
        self.mode = mode
        self._w8(_MODE_CONFIG, mode & 0x07)

    def clear_fifo(self):
        """Datasheet: clear FIFO_WR_PTR, OVF_COUNTER and FIFO_RD_PTR before a new conversion."""
        self._w8(_FIFO_WR_PTR, 0)
        self._w8(_OVF_COUNTER, 0)
        self._w8(_FIFO_RD_PTR, 0)

    def shutdown(self, off=True):
        m = self._r8(_MODE_CONFIG)
        self._w8(_MODE_CONFIG, (m | 0x80) if off else (m & 0x7F))

    def available(self):
        """Unread samples in the 16-deep FIFO (16 when it overflowed)."""
        wr = self._r8(_FIFO_WR_PTR) & 0x0F
        rd = self._r8(_FIFO_RD_PTR) & 0x0F
        if self._r8(_OVF_COUNTER) & 0x0F:
            return 16
        return (wr - rd) & 0x0F

    def read_fifo(self):
        """Return a list of (ir, red) raw 16-bit words (left-justified: MSB always bit 15)."""
        n = self.available()
        if not n:
            return []
        d = self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, _FIFO_DATA, 4 * n)
        out = []
        for i in range(n):
            j = 4 * i
            out.append(((d[j] << 8) | d[j + 1], (d[j + 2] << 8) | d[j + 3]))
        return out

    def temperature(self):
        """Die temperature in C: set TEMP_EN (self-clearing, ~29 ms), then TINT (two's complement) + TFRAC/16."""
        m = self._r8(_MODE_CONFIG)
        self._w8(_MODE_CONFIG, (m & 0x87) | 0x08)
        time.sleep_ms(29)
        t0 = time.ticks_ms()
        while self._r8(_MODE_CONFIG) & 0x08:
            if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), t0) > 100:
                break
            time.sleep_ms(2)
        ti = self._r8(_TEMP_INT)
        tf = self._r8(_TEMP_FRAC) & 0x0F
        if ti > 127:
            ti -= 256
        return ti + tf * 0.0625

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from max30100 import MAX30100

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}), freq=400000)
s = MAX30100(i2c)
print('part %02x' % s.part_id())
s.setup(sample_rate=100, pulse_width=1600, ir_current=0x6, red_current=0x6)
ir = []
while len(ir) < 800:
    for v_ir, v_red in s.read_fifo():
        ir.append(v_ir)
    time.sleep_ms(40)
lo = min(ir)
cut = (sum(ir) / len(ir) + lo) / 2
beats = []
for i in range(2, len(ir) - 2):
    if ir[i] < cut and ir[i] == min(ir[i - 2:i + 3]) and (not beats or i - beats[-1] > 25):
        beats.append(i)
print('BPM=%d' % round(60 * 100 * (len(beats) - 1) / (beats[-1] - beats[0])))
print('T=%.2fC' % s.temperature())
